svg.title: Same agent, two models
svg.desc: The same agent with Ministral 14B and with Gemini 3.8 Flash. Golden set: solved 71% and 81%, wrong answers 5% and 6% of answers given, refusals of answerable questions 18% and 2%. Sealed set 3, 40 unseen questions run once: solved 75% and 83%, wrong answers 8% and 3%, refusals of answerable questions 21% and 0%.
svg.text: only the model changed; the check is Gemini in both
